templates.name: Facilitator guide · question ladder
templates.purpose: One topic taken from open to probe to challenge to confirm, with an example question and its intent at each rung, and follow-ups for when the answer is vague.

slide.title: Question ladder for the estimates topic

steps.label: Rung 1
steps.title: Open
steps.text: “Walk me through the last time a patient asked what a visit would cost.” Intent: get the real story, not the policy. Move on when you hear a named step.

steps.label: Rung 2
steps.title: Probe
steps.text: “What happened next, and who did you hand it to?” Intent: trace handoffs and waiting time. Move on when each wait has an owner.

steps.label: Rung 3
steps.title: Challenge
steps.text: “If the estimate came before booking, what would break?” Intent: test assumptions and find the true constraint. Move on when the constraint is named.

steps.label: Rung 4
steps.title: Confirm
steps.text: “So the blocker is missing charge data. Is that right, and who owns it?” Intent: check we heard it and agree an owner. Move on when the table says yes.

items: The table names steps, owners and numbers, not opinions
Quiet participants are speaking by rung 3
Disagreement is stated out loud, not smoothed over
